latest.description: Default: current-generation models only (Qwen3.5, 2026) plus the 2026 ModernBERT classifier. The 9B pair is weak for Binoculars / Fast-DetectGPT on the controls (AUC about 0.6); the small base models carry the strongest token statistics and the combined score leans on those.

hybrid.description: Falcon-7B pair (2023; best measured pair for Binoculars / Fast-DetectGPT, AUC 0.80 / 0.79) with the Qwen3.5 small models. Kept for comparison; not the default because the Falcon models are 2023-era.

original.description: The Binoculars paper's reference pair and the thresholds derived for it (2023 models). Calibrated: reports state a Binoculars verdict. Select with --older-models.

dev.description: Development profile: small local models only, for fast iteration on the report. Not a detector recommendation.

falcon3.description: Bake-off candidate: Falcon3-7B base/instruct (2024, Apache 2.0) as observer/performer, with the default profile's small Qwen3.5 base models for token statistics. Uncalibrated.

smollm3.description: Bake-off candidate: SmolLM3-3B base/instruct (Hugging Face, 2025, Apache 2.0) as observer/performer, Qwen3.5 small models for token statistics.

olmo3.description: Bake-off candidate: OLMo-3 7B base (Olmo-3-1025-7B) / Olmo-3-7B-Instruct (Ai2, 2025-26, Apache 2.0, fully open training data) as observer/performer, Qwen3.5 small models for token statistics.
